description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewahamanduwa, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, extents, encumbrances, and servitude rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
